name: gm-one-stop-service
description: GM One Stop Service — monorepo workspace (S00 skeleton, no features yet)

scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api,worker --prefix-colors auto "npm run dev -w @gm/web" "npm run dev -w @gm/api" "npm run dev -w @gm/worker"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run check:deps && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
